rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something broad and comprehensive.

example.english: This report provides an all-encompassing analysis of Hong Kong's housing problems.
example.traditional: 呢份報告全面分析咗香港人嘅住屋問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 cyun4 min6 fan1 sik1 zo2 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 ge3 zyu6 uk1 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something contains or covers virtually everything.

example.english: This encyclopedia is all-encompassing, including even obscure information.
example.traditional: 呢本百科全書包羅萬有，連冷門嘅資料都有。
example.jyutping: nei1 bun2 baak3 fo1 cyun4 syu1 baau1 lo4 maan6 jau5 lin4 laang5 mun4 ge3 zi1 liu2 dou1 jau5

rows.note: Use this colloquial form when the context makes clear that all items or aspects are included.

example.english: This trip's itinerary is all-encompassing, covering food, accommodation, and entertainment.
example.traditional: 今次旅行嘅行程包晒食、住同玩。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 hang4 cing4 baau1 saai3 sik6 zyu6 tung4 waan2
